notes.title: Elven Holes Must Fall launches on 29/08 at 15:00 UTC
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44911523/43aafdcfd1ed54f3548ce6037a0676752c374c0b.jpg[/img]
The elven invasion turned the world into an empire of lust. Their queen gathers victims for a ritual to ascend as a demigoddess of desire.

Bran the dwarf — the only survivor of the fallen fortress. Armed with his hammer and battle brew, he sets out to cut through legions of seductresses and destroy the source of the cult.
